title: Opinions & discourse chunks (B1)
note: Last teaching unit before the checks. I'd say, in my view, on the other hand, it depends — plus the first hedging buds. Chunks, not grammar: they are learned whole. Feeds the b1_finale Use stage. First draft 2026-09-02. · 2026-09-04 B1 loop: **on the other hand** and **then again** carried the SAME Czech prompt (*na druhou stranu*), so a Match board could show two tiles a student has no way to tell apart. *then again* is now *ale zase*. · The **I'm not sure but** tile had no comma while every real sentence does, which is why its own frame never gapped; the tile is *I'm not sure, but* now. · sentences 8 → 36, one gappable frame per lemma. E10: Use is use_mode rewrite, 12 items — and on a discourse pack the paraphrase is exactly the job: *I think* → in my view, *But* → on the other hand, *nearly* → more or less. · C48: card 0's prose is a three-row table — what you want to do, and what you say. · Pool-checked against everything taught before trunk_opinions_b1 — 0 unknown types.

intro.title: Ways of saying what you think
intro.body_cz: Nejsou to nová fakta, ale fráze, kterými říkáš svůj názor. Angličtina jimi zmírňuje tvrzení, připouští druhou stranu nebo ukazuje míru jistoty. Zbytek věty zůstává normální.

rows: I'd say · in my view · if you ask me
on the other hand · then again · whereas
I suppose · more or less · to some extent

intro.title: You will use these words in
frames: On the other hand, … · *Na druhou stranu …*
I'm not sure, but … · *Nejsem si jistý, ale …*
intro.note: These are **chunks** — learn them whole, do not build them word by word.
intro.note_cz: Tohle jsou ustálené obraty. Uč se je celé.
